title: Gwaro reHutano hweMurwere - 9
instructions: Mumavhiki maviri apfuura, makambonetseka kangani nezvinhu zvinotevera?

questions.text: Kusava nechido kana mufaro pakuita zvinhu
Kunzwa kusuruvara, kuderera mwoyo, kana kusava netariro
Kunetseka kurara, kuramba wakarara, kana kurara zvakanyanya
Kunzwa zvakaipa pamusoro pako kana sekunge warasa iwe kana mhuri yako
Kunetseka kuisa pfungwa pazvinhu zvakaita sekuverenga kana kuona terevhizheni
Kufamba kana kutaura zvishoma zvekuti vamwe vanozviona, kana kusagadzikana zvekuti unofamba kupfuura zvakajairika
Mifungo yekuti zviri nani kudai wakafa kana kuzvikuvadza
